decision: Does a plane-strain poly-disperse Hertz-Mindlin + freeze-bond DEM of a ship-bow wedge penetrating a ridge keel (i) conserve mass and energy, (ii) produce force chains and Coulomb shear bands with the textbook orientations, and (iii) land within 30 % of a Lindqvist-family keel buoyancy-friction resistance anchor?
alternatives: DEM satisfies all criteria -> the grain-scale mechanism picture is consistent with the Lindqvist friction anchor at the 30 % level.
DEM satisfies C1-C6 but misses C7 -> anchor and mechanism disagree in magnitude; the deviation band is reported and the anchor stays WITHHELD, no threshold tuning.
Any of C1-C6 fails -> the DEM implementation is not yet trustworthy and the anchor comparison is not interpretable (honest FAIL).

outcome_metrics.C1_particle_conservation: number of particles identical at every step (no insertion/deletion)
outcome_metrics.C3_force_chain_angle: angle between the force-weighted strong-contact (F_n > 2 F_mean) direction and the major compressive principal stress direction < 15 deg
outcome_metrics.C4_shear_band_angle: theta_shear (band axis vs minor principal stress direction) in [45 + phi/2 - 10, 45 + phi/2 + 10] deg, phi from an independent biaxial test in the same engine
outcome_metrics.C5_chain_load_fraction: share of total normal force carried by contacts with F_n > 2 F_mean >= 0.60
outcome_metrics.C6_porosity_evolution: delta_phi (porosity change of the keel region, local packing measure) in [-0.10, +0.20]
outcome_metrics.C7_lindqvist: |F_DEM - F_Lindqvist| / F_Lindqvist < 0.30 with F_Lindqvist = mu_h * rho_i * g * (1 - n) * (h_k / sin(alpha))
outcome_metrics.C8_test_coverage: pytest tests/test_ridge_keel.py exercises C1-C7 and the anchor algebra

definitions_fixed_a_priori.force_chain: contact with normal force F_n > 2 * mean(F_n) over the measurement window; chains = connected components of the strong-contact graph
definitions_fixed_a_priori.major_principal_stress_direction: eigenvector of the contact stress tensor sigma_ij = -(1/A) sum_c f_i l_j (compression positive) with the largest compressive eigenvalue
definitions_fixed_a_priori.theta_shear: acute angle between the localized-band axis (gamma-weighted PCA of the upper-quartile shear-strain cells) and the minor principal stress direction in the same window; theoretical value 45 + phi/2 deg
definitions_fixed_a_priori.porosity: phi = 1 - nu, nu = per-particle local solid fraction from a Gaussian coarse-graining kernel (R = 1.5 * mean diameter), reported for keel-region particles alive in both windows
definitions_fixed_a_priori.F_DEM: time-averaged wedge face force per unit out-of-plane thickness [N/m] over the steady window s in [0.5, 1.0] * s_max
definitions_fixed_a_priori.F_Lindqvist: mu_h * rho_i * g * (1 - n) * h_k / sin(alpha), keel term only (no consolidated layer), coefficient set graded WITHHELD

fixed_parameters.primary_case: unbonded rubble (friction only), alpha = 30 deg, V = 1.0 m/s
fixed_parameters.bonded_case: same geometry with freeze bonds sigma_n = 20 kPa, sigma_t = 10 kPa
fixed_parameters.sensitivity: alpha in {15, 30, 45} deg at V = 1 m/s; V in {0.5, 1.0, 3.0} m/s at alpha = 30 deg

stopping_rule: penetration s = 4.0 m (half the keel mouldline half-width) or wall-clock 900 s per case, whichever first
repetition_rationale: one realisation per parameter point (2-D, N ~ 800 grains) with the steady-window average as the estimator; three speeds and three angles give the trend, and the primary case is repeated with a second seed to bound realisation noise
analysis: steady-window time averages; force/patch statistics unweighted means; energy residual relative to external work; all raw numbers exported to benchmarks/pending/ridge_keel/results/*.json
known_confounders: 2-D plane strain: out-of-plane rubble escape is not represented, so absolute resistance is a section value, not a 3-D ship load
freeze bonds are rate-independent springs with a strength cutoff: no viscoelastic ice creep
polydispersity is truncated at d in [0.15, 2.0] m; real keels carry sub-0.15 m fines
the lid represents the consolidated layer and is rigid (no cracking) -> it enforces no-heave, which biases resistance upward
